newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures dip to mixed levels into auction.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures dip to mixed levels into auction.

text.p: April 23 - U.S. debt futures slipped to mixed levels, as long end erased small overnight gains. Some said market needed a price concession to aid demand for today's 5-yr note sale. US Sen Lott said President Clinton must retreat from insistence on higher spending in budget plan, that time for final budget pact has arrived. June T-bonds face support near 107-27/32.
